description: Read the full metadata and media list of one of your own software items by software_id. Works for all statuses (pending, approved, rejected). Returns { tool, media } where media lists all uploaded screenshots/images with their ids. Use this to verify current state after set_metadata, to get media ids before calling delete_media, or to read current metadata before an update. Unlike get_software, this works with the internal software_id (not a public slug) and does not require the tool to be approved. Requires CRELA_API_KEY.
name: get_my_software_details
title: Get details of own Crela software
